events.title: Robert I of West Francia is killed at Soissons
events.description: King Robert I fell in battle against the deposed Carolingian Charles the Simple, though his side won the field. His grandson Hugh Capet later founded the Capetian dynasty.
events.html: King Robert I fell in battle against the deposed Carolingian Charles the Simple, though his side won the field. His grandson Hugh Capet later founded the Capetian dynasty.

events.title: King John agrees to Magna Carta at Runnymede
events.description: Facing rebel barons, John accepted a charter limiting royal power and promising justice under law. Though soon annulled, it was reissued and became a lasting symbol of constitutional government.
events.html: Facing rebel barons, John accepted a charter limiting royal power and promising justice under law. Though soon annulled, it was reissued and became a lasting symbol of constitutional government.

events.title: Serbs and Ottomans fight the Battle of Kosovo
events.description: Prince Lazar's Serbian army met Sultan Murad I's forces on the Field of Blackbirds; both rulers were killed. The battle weakened Serbia and became central to Serbian national memory.
events.html: Prince Lazar's Serbian army met Sultan Murad I's forces on the Field of Blackbirds; both rulers were killed. The battle weakened Serbia and became central to Serbian national memory.

events.title: Charles Goodyear patents vulcanised rubber
events.description: Goodyear patented his process of heating rubber with sulphur so that it stayed firm and elastic in heat and cold. Vulcanised rubber made possible tyres, seals and hoses.
events.html: Goodyear patented his process of heating rubber with sulphur so that it stayed firm and elastic in heat and cold. Vulcanised rubber made possible tyres, seals and hoses.

events.title: Hitler and Mussolini hold talks in Venice
events.description: At their first meeting, Mussolini was unimpressed by the German leader, and the two clashed over Austria. Within a few years they had drawn together in the Rome-Berlin Axis.
events.html: At their first meeting, Mussolini was unimpressed by the German leader, and the two clashed over Austria. Within a few years they had drawn together in the Rome-Berlin Axis.

events.title: Mount Pinatubo erupts in the Philippines
events.description: The second-largest eruption of the twentieth century sent ash 35 km into the sky. Its aerosols cooled global temperatures by about 0.5°C, and timely evacuations saved thousands of lives.
